sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.

sentences.en: Today.

sentences.en: As demand for COVID testing surges and vastly outstrips the supply of available tests, we look
sentences.zh: 随着新冠检测需求的激增并远远超过了现有检测供应量，我们来看看

sentences.en: at why shortages still remain two years into the pandemic, and what President Biden can do about it.
sentences.zh: 为什么疫情爆发两年后短缺问题依然存在，以及拜登总统能为此做些什么。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Cheryl Gay Stolbert.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔伯特。
zh_words: 谢丽尔·盖伊·斯托尔伯特

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, December 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月22日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, the way this day really begins is with me giving Michael Simon Johnson a better mask than the light blue surgical one he had.
sentences.zh: 这一天其实是从我给迈克尔·西蒙·约翰逊换了一个比他那浅蓝色医用口罩更好的口罩开始的。

sentences.en: Ooh, that is a fine-fitting KN95.
sentences.zh: 噢，那是一个非常贴合的KN95口罩。

sentences.en: Yeah, you can tell this is the real deal.
sentences.zh: 没错，看得出来这是正品。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, so it is around 8.40 a.m., and we are standing outside of a CareCube COVID testing clinic on Court Street and Wyckoff Street in Brooklyn, and the line
sentences.zh: 好的，现在大约是早上8点40分，我们正站在布鲁克林考特街和威科夫街交汇处的一家CareCube新冠检测诊所外，队伍

sentences.en: is quite long.
sentences.zh: 相当长。

sentences.en: It's about 40-something people on this line.
sentences.zh: 这条队伍里大概有40多个人。

sentences.en: And you can tell that people know they're going to be here for a really long time because they are prepared.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出人们知道他们会在这里待很长时间，因为他们都做好了准备。

sentences.en: They have their coffee and their snacks.
sentences.zh: 他们带着咖啡和零食。

sentences.en: There's a woman in the front doing jumping jacks, jumping up and down to stay warm.
sentences.zh: 前面有一位女士在做开合跳，蹦蹦跳跳地为了保持暖和。

sentences.en: There's a mother reading a board book to a not very happy child.
sentences.zh: 还有一位母亲正在给一个不太开心的孩子读绘本。

sentences.en: This is a really long line.
sentences.zh: 这队伍真的太长了。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a dishearteningly long line.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这队伍长得让人沮丧。

sentences.en: It's going to suck.
sentences.zh: 这会很糟糕。

sentences.en: Can we talk to you guys?
sentences.zh: 我们能跟你们聊聊吗？

sentences.en: We're from the
sentences.zh: 我们来自

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Do you have a minute?
sentences.zh: 有时间吗？

sentences.en: We're from the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我们来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: I just want to talk to people about long lines and COVID testing.
sentences.zh: 我只是想和大家聊聊排长队和新冠检测的事。

sentences.en: This is stupid.
sentences.zh: 这太蠢了。

sentences.en: Okay, tell me.
sentences.zh: 好的，告诉我。

sentences.en: This is stupid.
sentences.zh: 这太蠢了。

sentences.en: The test takes literally less than 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 检测过程实际上不到60秒。

sentences.en: I don't understand why I've been standing on this line for two hours.
sentences.zh: 我不明白为什么我在这条队伍里站了两个小时。

sentences.en: I mean, look at it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，看看它。

sentences.en: The line is going to be at Starbucks in a minute.
sentences.zh: 这队伍一会儿都要排到星巴克去了。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Eliza Reinhardt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫伊丽莎·莱因哈特。

sentences.en: Corey Deani and...
sentences.zh: 科里·迪尼和……

sentences.en: Nadia Deani.
sentences.zh: 娜迪亚·迪尼。

sentences.en: Sam.
sentences.zh: 萨姆。

sentences.en: Sam?
sentences.zh: 萨姆？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I am 26 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年26岁。

sentences.en: I'm a law student.
sentences.zh: 我是一名法学院学生。

sentences.en: Sam from the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 来自社区的萨姆。
我12岁。

sentences.en: Just turned 12.
sentences.zh: 刚满12岁。

sentences.en: Sam from the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 来自社区的萨姆。

sentences.en: My name is Melissa and I'm 32 and I work in the medical field.
sentences.zh: 我叫梅丽莎，今年32岁，在医疗领域工作。

sentences.en: What brought you to this line?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你来到这条队伍？

sentences.en: Why are you getting tested for COVID?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要进行新冠检测？

sentences.en: My friend at school tested positive.
sentences.zh: 我学校的朋友检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: So I'm exposed.
sentences.zh: 所以我接触过感染者。

sentences.en: So I'm getting tested and there's six minutes till school starts.
sentences.zh: 所以我来做检测，离上课还有六分钟。

sentences.en: Actually, there's probably three minutes till school starts.
sentences.zh: 其实，离上课大概还有三分钟。

sentences.en: Can we ask you who you are?
sentences.zh: 能问问你是谁吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm Sam and I feel sick.
sentences.zh: 好的，我是萨姆，我感觉不舒服。

sentences.en: So that's why I'm here.
sentences.zh: 所以我在这儿。

sentences.en: What do you think may have been the source of your exposure?
sentences.zh: 你认为你的接触来源可能是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's like I had a really great weekend.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我度过了一个非常棒的周末。

sentences.en: I had a bunch of friends coming in and visiting and we went out and...
sentences.zh: 我有一群朋友来访，我们出去玩了，然后……

sentences.en: It was her birthday.
sentences.zh: 那是她的生日。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was my birthday.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是我的生日。

sentences.en: It was your birthday.
sentences.zh: 那是你的生日。

sentences.en: Did you have that moment right before or during of asking yourself, like, is this a great idea?
sentences.zh: 在那之前或期间，你有没有那一刻问过自己，这真的是个好主意吗？

sentences.en: Um, I think there was, like, concern that, like, we could be safer, but I also think we have to live our lives to some extent.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想确实有担心，觉得我们可以更安全一些，但我也认为我们在某种程度上必须过自己的生活。

sentences.en: So, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't have any work out.
sentences.zh: 我没有工作。

sentences.en: We was actually here for four hours yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天其实在这里排了四个小时。

sentences.en: And I had to work yesterday and today.
sentences.zh: 我昨天和今天都得工作。

sentences.en: But I can't go back until I have a negative COVID teSt. So, it is frustrating.
sentences.zh: 但我必须拿到新冠阴性检测结果才能回去。所以，这很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: What kind of line of work are you in that they require you to get tested like this every day?
sentences.zh: 你是从事什么工作的，需要你每天这样去检测？

sentences.en: Retail.
sentences.zh: 零售业。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, how can you work in retail if you're standing in line for four hours twice in a week?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你一周两次排队四个小时，怎么能从事零售业工作呢？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I know I need to make up to $500 for these two days I loSt.
sentences.zh: 我知道我需要赚回我这两天损失的500美元。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's incredible.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: We just want to say $500 worth of your time and hourly wages you're standing in this line.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想说，你花在排队上的时间价值500美元的时薪。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, work in retail.
sentences.zh: 所以，在零售业工作。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, so, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以，是的。

sentences.en: It's kind of tough.
sentences.zh: 这有点艰难。

sentences.en: It's kind of tough.
sentences.zh: 这有点艰难。

sentences.en: We had, like, a conversation the other day at my school about, like, when do you think or do you think this is going to end?
sentences.zh: 我们前几天在学校讨论过，你认为或者你觉得这一切什么时候会结束？

sentences.en: And I think that it's going to get worse to get better.
sentences.zh: 我认为情况会先变糟，然后才会变好。

sentences.en: Like, it's going to get a little bit more challenging to eventually be over.
sentences.zh: 就像，它会变得更具挑战性，最终才会结束。

sentences.en: So, your attitude about the future of the pandemic is basically that the night is darkest just before the dawn.
sentences.zh: 所以，你对疫情未来的态度基本上是黎明前的黑暗最深沉？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To quote a Batman.
sentences.zh: 引用蝙蝠侠的话。

sentences.en: Well, I think that it's going to, we're going to all have to take many more precautions and maybe new, like, strategies of precautions before it's going to fully be over.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们将不得不采取更多的预防措施，也许在完全结束之前会有新的预防策略。

sentences.en: Are you mentally ready to do that?
sentences.zh: 你心理上准备好那样做了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, any final thoughts here?
sentences.zh: 那么，最后有什么想法吗？

sentences.en: If you're sick and want to spend four hours waiting in line, bring gloves.
sentences.zh: 如果你生病了又想花四个小时排队，带上手套。

sentences.en: Cheryl, I was just out in the bitter cold speaking to a lot of very frustrated New Yorkers
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，我刚才在严寒中采访了许多非常沮丧的纽约人，

sentences.en: who are in line waiting for a COVID teSt. And New York City is in a somewhat unique situation given its scale and demographics.
sentences.zh: 他们正在排队等待新冠检测。考虑到纽约市的规模和人口结构，它处于一种相当独特的情况。

sentences.en: But by and large, it feels like testing isn't really working right now at the peak of Omicron.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，感觉在奥密克戎毒株肆虐的高峰期，检测系统并没有真正发挥作用。

sentences.en: So, we want to talk to you about why why it is that testing is still such a mess in the United States now, two years into this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们想和你谈谈为什么在美国，疫情爆发两年后的今天，检测仍然是一团糟。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, the United States really bungled testing from the outset of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，美国在疫情初期确实把检测搞砸了。

sentences.en: You'll probably remember that in the early days, the CDC wanted to keep tight control over testing.
sentences.zh: 你可能记得在早期，疾控中心（CDC）想要严格控制检测。

sentences.en: They felt that their test was the gold standard, and they didn't want anybody else's tests to be used.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他们的检测是黄金标准，不想使用其他人的检测方法。

sentences.en: And then it turned out that their test kits were botched, that they were problematic.
sentences.zh: 结果发现他们的检测试剂盒搞砸了，存在问题。

sentences.en: They didn't work.
sentences.zh: 它们根本没用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, we really started out behind the curve.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们确实从一开始就落后了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what I remember is, in keeping such tight reins over testing, and ultimately creating a botched test like you said, the CDC kind of set back the schedule for private companies
sentences.zh: 我记得的是，由于对检测控制得太紧，最终像你所说的那样制造了一个拙劣的检测，CDC在某种程度上推迟了私营公司

sentences.en: to jump in and create a lot of tests for the United States.
sentences.zh: 介入并为美国制造大量检测工具的时间表。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not only did it set back the schedule, but the virus was already kind of in full swing by the time we got tests that we could use.
sentences.zh: 这不仅推迟了时间表，而且当我们拿到可以使用的检测工具时，病毒已经处于全面爆发状态了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember talking to governors who were begging the Trump administration, please send us tests.
sentences.zh: 我记得曾与那些恳求特朗普政府给我们发送检测工具的州长们交谈。

sentences.en: They were literally competing with one another for these scarce tests.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是在为这些稀缺的检测工具相互竞争。

sentences.en: And testing was a huge issue all throughout the spring of 2020.
sentences.zh: 在2020年整个春季，检测都是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, then in April of last year, President Trump invoked the Defense Production Act.
sentences.zh: 所以，去年四月，特朗普总统援引了《国防生产法》。

sentences.en: That's a Korean War-era law that gives the president broad powers to direct companies to prioritize shipments to the government.
sentences.zh: 那是一项朝鲜战争时期的法律，赋予总统广泛的权力，指示公司优先向政府发货。

sentences.en: And after that happened, and after private companies started really scaling up the supply of coronavirus tests, things started to even out toward the end of last year,
sentences.zh: 在那之后，随着私营公司开始真正扩大新冠病毒检测的供应，去年年底情况开始趋于平稳，

sentences.en: it was pretty much the case that if you needed a coronavirus test, you could get one.
sentences.zh: 基本上如果你需要新冠病毒检测，你就能得到一个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, a year in, at that late stage, testing is finally at a somewhat okay place in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，一年过去了，在那个后期阶段，美国的检测终于处于一个还算可以的水平。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then, Michael, the vaccines arrived.
sentences.zh: 然后，迈克尔，疫苗出现了。

sentences.en: I feel hopeful today.
sentences.zh: 我今天感到充满希望。

sentences.en: Relieved.
sentences.zh: 感到如释重负。

sentences.en: I feel like healing is coming.
sentences.zh: 我觉得治愈即将来临。

sentences.en: The talk was all about vaccines.
sentences.zh: 当时的谈话全是关于疫苗的。

sentences.en: Once we get enough people to get us vaccinated, we can kiss COVID goodbye.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们有足够多的人接种疫苗，我们就可以和新冠说再见了。

sentences.en: Can you get vaccines?
sentences.zh: 你能接种疫苗吗？

sentences.en: Can you get on the list?
sentences.zh: 你能排上名单吗？

sentences.en: You have to check multiple times a day, and you have to check multiple sites to get that appointment.
sentences.zh: 你必须每天检查多次，并且必须检查多个网站才能预约到。

sentences.en: People who were vaccinated felt like, we don't need to test because we've got this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 接种过疫苗的人觉得，我们不需要检测，因为我们已经接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: And demand really took a nosedive.
sentences.zh: 需求确实大幅下降了。

sentences.en: Both Georgia and South Carolina are not meeting testing goals.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州和南卡罗来纳州都没有达到检测目标。

sentences.en: Part of the cause could be an increase in vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 部分原因可能是疫苗接种率的提高。

sentences.en: And testing sites started closing down, too.
sentences.zh: 检测点也开始关闭了。

sentences.en: Mayor Lenny Curry says the plan is to convert the Legends and Regency testing centers into vaccination sites by early 90s.
sentences.zh: 莱尼·柯里市长表示，计划在90年代初之前将Legends和Regency检测中心改建为疫苗接种点。

sentences.en: People who were running testing sites were trying to convert those sites into vaccination sites because that's where the demand was.
sentences.zh: 那些运营检测点的人正试图将这些站点转为疫苗接种点，因为那才是需求所在。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So much so that a major test manufacturer, Abbott Laboratories...
sentences.zh: 以至于一家大型检测设备制造商，雅培实验室……

sentences.en: One of the leading producers of these tests reportedly began destroying inventory with a limited shelf life.
sentences.zh: 据报道，这些检测设备的主要生产商之一开始销毁保质期有限的库存。

sentences.en: They wound up destroying millions of tests that they had worked so hard to create.
sentences.zh: 他们最终销毁了数百万个他们曾努力研发出来的检测试剂。

sentences.en: And stuffed them into garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 并把它们塞进了垃圾袋里。

sentences.en: And was anyone saying at that point to themselves, well, wait a minute, pandemics are cyclical.
sentences.zh: 当时有没有人对自己说，等一下，大流行病是有周期性的。

sentences.en: We're maybe going to need more testing soon enough.
sentences.zh: 我们可能很快又需要更多的检测了。

sentences.en: Well, certainly a number of public health experts were saying we were going to need more testing
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然有一些公共卫生专家一直在说我们需要更多的检测，

sentences.en: and that testing should always have been integrated into the response, even with vaccination.
sentences.zh: 而且即使在有了疫苗的情况下，检测也应该始终被纳入应对措施中。

sentences.en: That the singular focus the Biden administration had on vaccination was somewhat misguided and that we needed a layered approach that would involve testing, vaccination, masking,
sentences.zh: 拜登政府对疫苗接种的单一关注在某种程度上是误导性的，我们需要一种包含检测、疫苗接种、佩戴口罩的多层次方法，

sentences.en: and other public health measures like social distancing.
sentences.zh: 以及其他公共卫生措施，比如保持社交距离。

sentences.en: But instead, Americans seem to be able to do only one thing at a time.
sentences.zh: 但相反，美国人似乎一次只能做一件事。

sentences.en: And what is the result of all of us collectively taking our eyes off testing?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们集体忽视检测的后果是什么呢？

sentences.en: The result is that now we have this new variant, Omicron, and there is a huge demand for tests because we know that people who are vaccinated can still get infected.
sentences.zh: 结果就是现在我们有了这个新变种——奥密克戎，而且对检测的需求巨大，因为我们知道接种过疫苗的人仍然可能被感染。

sentences.en: And this is creating major strains on the United States testing system.
sentences.zh: 这给美国的检测系统造成了巨大的压力。

sentences.en: The new rapid tests, which have come online since President Biden took office, are flying off pharmacy shelves.
sentences.zh: 自拜登总统上任以来推出的新型快速检测试剂，在药店货架上被抢购一空。

sentences.en: There are waits for PCR tests like you yourself just saw, Michael.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才亲眼所见，迈克尔，PCR检测需要排队。

sentences.en: You were standing out in line in the cold.
sentences.zh: 你当时站在寒风中排队。

sentences.en: Three to four hours.
sentences.zh: 排了三到四个小时。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And laboratories that process those tests are overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 而处理这些检测的实验室已经不堪重负。

sentences.en: There are delays in processing time, just like there were at the very beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 处理时间出现了延误，就像大流行刚开始时那样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So let's dig into the data on testing right now.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们深入了解一下目前的检测数据。

sentences.en: Just how many tests are there in this moment?
sentences.zh: 此刻到底有多少检测试剂？

sentences.en: And how does that align with the demand now that Omicron is here?
sentences.zh: 随着奥密克戎的到来，这些试剂如何满足现在的需求？

sentences.en: So the latest estimates show that right now in December of 2021, we have a total of 593 million tests in the country.
sentences.zh: 最新的估计显示，就在2021年12月的现在，我们全国总共有5.93亿份检测试剂。

sentences.en: And that's all kinds of tests.
sentences.zh: 这涵盖了各种类型的检测。

sentences.en: That is at-home tests.
sentences.zh: 包括居家检测试剂。

sentences.en: It's professional tests at your doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 也包括医生办公室的专业检测。

sentences.en: It's PCR tests.
sentences.zh: 还有PCR检测。

sentences.en: So almost 600 million tests.
sentences.zh: 所以总共近6亿份检测。

sentences.en: That sounds like a lot of tests.
sentences.zh: 听起来检测数量很多。

sentences.en: It does sound like a lot, Michael, but think about how many Americans there are.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实很多，迈克尔，但想想美国有多少人。

sentences.en: There are about 330 million Americans.
sentences.zh: 大约有3.3亿美国人。

sentences.en: So that's just really not quite two tests for the whole month for every American.
sentences.zh: 所以算下来，每个美国人整个月还分不到两份检测。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it might sound like a lot, but it's not.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来可能很多，但其实不然。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And when you think about the need for tests, it becomes even more complicated.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑到对检测的需求时，情况就变得更加复杂了。

sentences.en: There are parents who have three kids.
sentences.zh: 有的家长有三个孩子。

sentences.en: And anytime there's a potential exposure in that family, I'm thinking about a colleague of mine, that's five tests.
sentences.zh: 只要家里有潜在的接触风险——我想到我的一位同事——就需要五份检测。

sentences.en: Or let's say you work at a company that requires testing.
sentences.zh: 或者假设你在一家要求检测的公司工作。

sentences.en: To go back to work, you might need multiple tests a month, three tests a month.
sentences.zh: 为了重返工作岗位，你可能一个月需要多次检测，一个月三次。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or let's say you're a school.
sentences.zh: 或者假设你是在学校。

sentences.en: The CDC announced this week its new strategy of what they call test to stay,
sentences.zh: 疾控中心本周宣布了他们所谓“检测以留校”的新策略，

sentences.en: which means that students who are exposed to the coronavirus can test to stay in school instead of having to quarantine at home.
sentences.zh: 这意味着接触过新冠病毒的学生可以通过检测留在学校，而不必在家隔离。

sentences.en: Well, if you've got a school and a classroom of 30 kids or two or three classrooms of 30 kids are all exposed, you know,
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你有一所学校，一个30人的班级，或者两三个30人的班级都接触了病毒，你知道，

sentences.en: you can do the math and see that you're going to need a lot of tests.
sentences.zh: 你算一下就会发现，你需要大量的检测试剂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, 600 million tests a month, which does sound like a lot, gets used up very quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，一个月6亿份检测——听起来确实很多——很快就会用完。

sentences.en: And as we can see from these long lines, it's not sufficient.
sentences.zh: 正如我们从这些长队中看到的，这还不够。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Do we have a sense of what would be a sufficient number?
sentences.zh: 我们知道多少数量才算充足吗？

sentences.en: You know, I don't think anybody knows.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得没人知道。

sentences.en: I asked that question of Mara Espinall.
sentences.zh: 我问过玛拉·埃斯皮纳尔这个问题。

sentences.en: She's an expert in medical diagnostics at Arizona State University who keeps those numbers that I just gave to you.
sentences.zh: 她是亚利桑那州立大学的医学诊断专家，负责维护我刚才给你的那些数据。

sentences.en: And she paused for a minute and she said, well, significantly more.
sentences.zh: 她停顿了一会儿说，嗯，需要多得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: More than we currently have.
sentences.zh: 比我们目前拥有的要多。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And so the system we have now is if you need a test,
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在的系统是，如果你需要检测，

sentences.en: you either wait in a really long line for a laboratory test or you try to buy an at-home test from the pharmacy where they're in short supply and they're also costly,
sentences.zh: 要么在长队中等待实验室检测，要么尝试从药店购买居家检测试剂，但那里供应短缺，而且价格昂贵，

sentences.en: usually about $25 for a package of two.
sentences.zh: 通常两份装的要25美元左右。

sentences.en: And people are feeling a lot of frustration over that.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Why are the at-home tests so expensive?
sentences.zh: 为什么居家检测试剂这么贵？

sentences.en: I think any of us who've ever walked into a store and bought them experiences some level of sticker shock.
sentences.zh: 我想任何走进商店购买过它们的人都会感到某种程度的“价格冲击”。

sentences.en: So I think part of that has to do with the old supply and demand because the FDA was slow to approve these rapid tests.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这部分与传统的供需关系有关，因为FDA批准这些快速检测的速度很慢。

sentences.en: There are only, you know, a few companies making them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，只有少数几家公司在生产。

sentences.en: There are about a dozen on the market so they can set their price.
sentences.zh: 市场上大约有十几家，所以他们可以定价。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration also made a crucial decision, which is that unlike nations in Europe where the government bought tests directly from manufacturers,
sentences.zh: 拜登政府也做出了一个关键决定，即与欧洲国家不同，欧洲政府直接从制造商那里购买检测产品，

sentences.en: creating a ready market, the United States didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 创造了一个现成的市场，而美国没有这样做。

sentences.en: So in Europe, tests are maybe $1 or $2 a piece.
sentences.zh: 所以在欧洲，检测可能每份只要1或2美元。

sentences.en: And in the United States, they're roughly $12.50 a piece or $25 for a box of two, which is how they're sold.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，大约是每份12.50美元，或者两份装的25美元，这是它们的销售方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So to sum this all up, the reason why testing remains slow and disorganized at this late stage of the pandemic is because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，在大流行病的这个后期阶段，检测仍然缓慢且混乱的原因是美国

sentences.en: got off to a very late start.
sentences.zh: 起步非常晚。

sentences.en: And then everyone took their eye off the ball, focusing on vaccines instead.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人都转移了注意力，转而专注于疫苗。

sentences.en: And now there's a real mismatch between supply and demand.
sentences.zh: 现在供需之间存在真正的错位。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且美国

sentences.en: is not subsidizing testing in the same way that countries in Europe are to make up for all that.
sentences.zh: 并没有像欧洲国家那样补贴检测来弥补这一切。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that sets the stage for what President Biden did on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 这为拜登总统周二的行动奠定了基础。

sentences.en: He's recognizing that we are facing an alarming surge in coronavirus cases because of Omicron that threatened to overwhelm the hospital system.
sentences.zh: 他认识到，由于奥密克戎，我们正面临新冠病例的惊人激增，这威胁到医疗系统，使其不堪重负。

sentences.en: So he gave a really big speech talking about what he's going to do about that.
sentences.zh: 所以他发表了一场非常重要的演讲，谈论他将如何应对。

sentences.en: And a lot of that speech and Biden's new strategy has to do with testing.
sentences.zh: 那场演讲和拜登的新策略很大程度上与检测有关。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店当DJ时，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽、50年历史文物的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报APP，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I promised when I got elected I'd always give it to you straight from the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 我当选时承诺过，我会直言不讳。

sentences.en: The good, the bad, the truth.
sentences.zh: 好的、坏的、真相。

sentences.en: So as we head into Christmas weekend, I want to answer your questions about the rising number of COVID cases, COVID-19 cases.
sentences.zh: 所以，在进入圣诞周末之际，我想回答你们关于新冠病例不断增加的问题。

sentences.en: So Cheryl, what did President Biden say in this speech?
sentences.zh: 那么谢丽尔，拜登总统在演讲中说了什么？

sentences.en: So before he even got to his new plan, he really tried to console an anxious nation.
sentences.zh: 在提出他的新计划之前，他确实试图安抚一个焦虑的国家。

sentences.en: We should all be concerned about Omicron, but not panicked.
sentences.zh: 我们都应该关注奥密克戎，但不必恐慌。

sentences.en: If you're fully vaccinated, and especially if you got your booster shot, you are highly protected.
sentences.zh: 如果你已完全接种疫苗，特别是如果你打了加强针，你就受到了高度保护。

sentences.en: He told Americans that we should all be concerned about Omicron, but not panicked.
sentences.zh: 他告诉美国人，我们都应该关注奥密克戎，但不必恐慌。

sentences.en: Another question that folks are asking is, are we going back to March 2020?
sentences.zh: 人们问的另一个问题是，我们会回到2020年3月吗？

sentences.en: He tried to draw a contrast between now and March of 2020, which is when his predecessor declared a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 他试图在现在与2020年3月之间划清界限，那是他前任宣布国家进入紧急状态的时候。

sentences.en: That's what I keep getting asked.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直被问到的问题。

sentences.en: The answer is absolutely no.
sentences.zh: 答案是绝对不会。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: He said this is not March 2020.
sentences.zh: 他说现在不是2020年3月。

sentences.en: More than 200 million Americans have been fully vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 超过2亿美国人已经完全接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: 200 million people are vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 2亿人接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: We're prepared.
sentences.zh: 我们准备好了。

sentences.en: We know more.
sentences.zh: 我们了解得更多了。

sentences.en: In March of 2020, we were not ready.
sentences.zh: 在2020年3月，我们还没有准备好。

sentences.en: And I know some Americans are wondering if you can safely celebrate the holidays with your family and friends.
sentences.zh: 我知道一些美国人在想，是否可以安全地与家人和朋友共度节日。

sentences.en: The answer is yes, you can.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的，可以。

sentences.en: If you and those you celebrate with are vaccinated, particularly if you've gotten your booster shot.
sentences.zh: 如果你和你一起庆祝的人都接种了疫苗，特别是如果你打了加强针的话。

sentences.en: He told people that if they're vaccinated, they should feel comfortable going about their holiday business,
sentences.zh: 他告诉人们，如果他们接种了疫苗，就应该放心地进行节日活动，

sentences.en: so long as they follow other public health protocols like masking when indoors and social distancing and washing their hands, etc.
sentences.zh: 只要他们遵循其他公共卫生协议，比如在室内佩戴口罩、保持社交距离、勤洗手等。

sentences.en: While COVID has been a tough adversary, we've shown that we're tougher.
sentences.zh: 虽然新冠病毒一直是一个强硬的对手，但我们已经证明我们更强硬。

sentences.en: So very much a message of calm, but stay vigilant.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是一个冷静但要保持警惕的信息。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And when he gets to his new plans, especially for testing, what are the details?
sentences.zh: 当他谈到他的新计划，特别是关于检测的计划时，细节是什么？

sentences.en: So the details on testing are that...
sentences.zh: 关于检测的细节是……

sentences.en: The federal government will purchase one half billion, that's not million, billion with a B, additional at-home rapid tests.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府将额外购买5亿份——不是百万，是十亿，B开头的十亿——居家快速检测试剂。

sentences.en: His administration is buying 500 million rapid COVID-19 tests to distribute free to the public beginning in January.
sentences.zh: 他的政府正在购买5亿份新冠快速检测试剂，从1月份开始免费分发给公众。

sentences.en: And we'll have websites where you can get them delivered to your home.
sentences.zh: 我们将会有网站，你可以通过网站将它们送到家中。

sentences.en: This will happen over a new website where Americans can go on this website and ask for tests to be sent to them, and the tests will be sent.
sentences.zh: 这将通过一个新的网站实现，美国人可以登录这个网站申请将检测包寄给他们，然后检测包就会被寄出。

sentences.en: Although I have to add, Michael, that it was a little scant on the details.
sentences.zh: 虽然我必须补充一点，迈克尔，细节有点匮乏。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what is the logic of sending 500 million tests to Americans at home?
sentences.zh: 那么向美国人居家发送5亿份检测试剂的逻辑是什么？

sentences.en: I think the logic is twofold.
sentences.zh: 我认为逻辑有两点。

sentences.en: First, we want tests because we have new therapies, new antiviral pills coming online.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们需要检测，因为我们有新的疗法，新的抗病毒药片即将上市。

sentences.en: And if they're going to work, they need to be administered early on.
sentences.zh: 如果它们要发挥作用，就需要尽早使用。

sentences.en: So you want tests so that people can know whether or not they're sick if they're experiencing symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要检测，这样人们在出现症状时就能知道自己是否生病了。

sentences.en: Right, because then they can actually get these pills that might, in many cases, make their experience of COVID much milder or, in some cases, save their lives.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这样他们就能真正获得这些药片，在许多情况下，这些药片可能会使他们的新冠症状变得轻微，甚至在某些情况下挽救他们的生命。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the second reason we want tests is so that we can all go about our daily lives, so that we can continue to go to work and to school,
sentences.zh: 但我们想要检测的第二个原因是，这样我们所有人都能继续日常生活，这样我们就能继续工作和上学，

sentences.en: so that people can gather and feel comfortable about gathering.
sentences.zh: 这样人们就可以聚会，并对聚会感到安心。

sentences.en: Especially because we know that this Omicron variant can infect people who are vaccinated, but it often causes only mild or no symptoms,
sentences.zh: 特别是我们知道奥密克戎变种可以感染接种过疫苗的人，但它通常只会引起轻微症状或无症状，

sentences.en: which means that you could be carrying it and passing it on to other people, vulnerable people, like the elderly or the immunosuppressed, without even knowing it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可能携带病毒并将其传染给其他人，比如老年人或免疫功能低下者，而你自己却毫不知情。

sentences.en: So if you were going to be in the company of such people, let's say you were going to go visit with a cancer patient,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你要和这些人在一起，比如说你要去探望一位癌症患者，

sentences.en: you would want to take a test first just to assure yourself that you weren't bringing in a deadly disease.
sentences.zh: 你会想先做个检测，以确保自己没有携带致命的疾病。

sentences.en: Cheryl, you said that the details for distributing these 500 million at-home tests were scant.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，你说分发这5亿份居家检测试剂的细节很匮乏。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Are these going to come by mail?
sentences.zh: 这些是通过邮寄方式送达吗？

sentences.en: Who's going to be eligible?
sentences.zh: 谁有资格领取？

sentences.en: How many could each person's family get?
sentences.zh: 每个人的家庭能拿到多少？

sentences.en: I think the answer to who's going to be eligible is everybody's eligible.
sentences.zh: 关于谁有资格的问题，我认为答案是人人都有资格。

sentences.en: But we don't know how these tests are going to be sent, and whether there will be limits on how many you can order at one time,
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道这些检测盒将如何发放，也不知道一次能订购的数量是否有限制，

sentences.en: and also whether there will be any priorities for how they're used.
sentences.zh: 也不知道在使用上是否会有优先顺序。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: From what you said earlier, that's basically a month's supply of testing in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据你刚才所说的，这基本上是美国一个月的检测供应量。

sentences.en: Yes, and that is if these 500 million all come online in one month.
sentences.zh: 是的，前提是这5亿份检测盒都能在一个月内上线。

sentences.en: And that, experts say that's actually unlikely.
sentences.zh: 而专家表示，这实际上不太可能。

sentences.en: I just got off the phone with Dr. Michael Mina, who is a former professor of public health at Harvard, and he now works for an eMed,
sentences.zh: 我刚和迈克尔·米纳博士通完电话，他曾是哈佛大学公共卫生教授，现在就职于eMed，

sentences.en: which is a company that distributes coronavirus tests.
sentences.zh: 这是一家分销新冠病毒检测盒的公司。

sentences.en: And he has been calling for two years for the government to ramp up testing.
sentences.zh: 两年来，他一直呼吁政府加大检测力度。

sentences.en: And he said he expects that these 500 million tests will roll out over a period of months and will not be available all at once.
sentences.zh: 他说他预计这5亿份检测盒将在几个月内陆续投放，不会一次性全部到位。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So does he think it will make much of a dent in the testing shortage?
sentences.zh: 那么他认为这能在多大程度上缓解检测短缺的问题？

sentences.en: He and other experts I've talked to think that it's a good start, but it's inadequate.
sentences.zh: 他和我也交谈过的其他专家都认为，这是一个好的开始，但还不够。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what else did the president say in his speech about testing?
sentences.zh: 那么总统在演讲中还说了哪些关于检测的内容？

sentences.en: Starting this week, the federal government will set up emergency testing sites in areas that need additional testing capacity.
sentences.zh: 从本周开始，联邦政府将在需要额外检测能力的地区设立紧急检测点。

sentences.en: Well, he said that he's going to open up some new testing sites.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说他将开设一些新的检测点。

sentences.en: Before Christmas, the first several of these federal testing sites will be up and running in New York City, with many more to come.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前，首批几个联邦检测点将在纽约市投入运营，未来还会有更多。

sentences.en: And that will start right away in New York City, where there will be several new federally run testing sites, and they expect to scale that up in other places,
sentences.zh: 这将在纽约市立即开始，那里将有几个新的联邦运营检测点，他们预计会在其他地方扩大规模，

sentences.en: although we don't know how many places and how many sites.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们不知道具体有多少个地方和多少个检测点。

sentences.en: This free testing is going to help reduce the waiting lines, the time you have to stand there, and sometimes it's an hour more.
sentences.zh: 这种免费检测将有助于减少排队，减少你必须站在那里的时间，有时甚至要等一个多小时。

sentences.en: So in addition to making it easier to test yourself at home, he wants to make it easier for people to go and get tested.
sentences.zh: 所以除了让居家自测变得更容易之外，他还希望让人们更容易去现场接受检测。

sentences.en: So these would be large-scale, presumably, federally funded testing sites?
sentences.zh: 那么这些应该是大规模的、大概是联邦资助的检测点吗？

sentences.en: I think we can say these would be federally funded testing sites.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可以说这些将是联邦资助的检测点。

sentences.en: I don't know if they'll be large-scale or small-scale or what scale.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它们是大规模还是小规模，或者是什么规模。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm sensing a theme here of not that many details.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到一个主题，那就是细节不多。

sentences.en: Uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，是的。

sentences.en: I'm feeling like there are a lot of things that I would like to know, a lot of questions that I would like answered that I don't yet have answers to.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有很多我想知道的事情，有很多我想得到答案的问题，但我还没有答案。

sentences.en: In addition, I've directed the Pentagon to mobilize an additional 1,000 troops to be deployed to help staff local hospitals and expand capacity.
sentences.zh: 此外，我已经指示五角大楼动员额外1000名士兵，部署以帮助当地医院配备人员并扩大容量。

sentences.en: I think the speech on Tuesday was a recognition that the administration needed to act and act more aggressively than they have.
sentences.zh: 我认为周二的演讲是对政府需要采取行动，并且比以往更积极地采取行动的一种认可。

sentences.en: You also saw him say that 1,000 military personnel would be at the ready to go to hospitals to keep them from getting overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 你也看到他说，1000名军事人员将随时准备前往医院，以防止医院不堪重负。

sentences.en: I've ordered FEMA, the Federal Emergency Management Agency, to stand up new pop-up vaccination clinics.
sentences.zh: 我已经命令联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）建立新的临时疫苗接种诊所。

sentences.en: There would be vaccinators sent out.
sentences.zh: 会有疫苗接种人员被派往各地。

sentences.en: They are going to send ventilators across the country to states.
sentences.zh: 他们将向全国各州运送呼吸机。

sentences.en: They're going to open up new pop-up vaccine clinics and take other steps to make sure that the nation can withstand this surge.
sentences.zh: 他们将开设新的临时疫苗诊所，并采取其他措施，确保国家能够抵御这波疫情。

sentences.en: Does this plan, Cheryl, feel up to the task, given especially where COVID testing is in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，考虑到美国目前的COVID检测状况，你觉得这个计划能胜任吗？

sentences.en: right now?
sentences.zh: 就在当下？

sentences.en: So, that's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: But I think we need to talk about what the task is.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们需要讨论一下任务是什么。

sentences.en: And this plan and NOAA plan can stop the spread of this virus.
sentences.zh: 这个计划和NOAA计划无法阻止这种病毒的传播。

sentences.en: So, the task is really to slow the spread and to use testing to prevent the most vulnerable people from getting sick and to prevent hospitals from getting overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 所以，真正的任务是减缓传播，并利用检测来防止最脆弱的人群生病，防止医院不堪重负。

sentences.en: May God bless you all, and may God protect our troops.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人，愿上帝保护我们的军队。

sentences.en: And happy holidays.
sentences.zh: 祝大家节日快乐。

sentences.en: God love you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝爱你们所有人。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Mr. President, Mr. President, Mr. President, Mr. President, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，总统先生，总统先生，总统先生，总统先生。

sentences.en: And after the speech, the president faced some pretty tough questions from reporters who asked, is this a failure of your administration?
sentences.zh: 演讲结束后，总统面临记者们提出的一些相当尖锐的问题，他们问，这是你们政府的失败吗？

sentences.en: Should you have acted sooner?
sentences.zh: 你们本应该早点采取行动吗？

sentences.en: Mr. President, what's your message to Americans who are trying to get tested now and who are not able to get tested and who are wondering what took so long to ramp up testing?
sentences.zh: 总统先生，对于那些现在想做检测却无法进行，并且想知道为什么加大检测力度花了这么长时间的美国人，你想传达什么信息？

sentences.en: Come on, what took so long?
sentences.zh: 得了吧，为什么花了这么长时间？

sentences.en: I'm hearing that from people who are...
sentences.zh: 我从那些人那里听到的是……

sentences.en: And he got a little testy about it.
sentences.zh: 他对此有点恼火。

sentences.en: What happened was the Omicron virus spread even more rapidly than anybody thought.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是奥密克戎病毒的传播速度比任何人想象的都要快。

sentences.en: If I had told you...
sentences.zh: 如果我早告诉你……

sentences.en: And said, no, it wasn't a failure, that they couldn't have seen Omicron coming.
sentences.zh: 并说，不，这不是失败，他们不可能预见到奥密克戎的到来。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What did you make of that exchange?
sentences.zh: 你对这次交流有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, it echoed what his vice president, Kamala Harris, said recently.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这呼应了他的副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯最近所说的话。

sentences.en: But his answer flies in the face of what experts say, which is that we could have and should have seen it coming.
sentences.zh: 但他的回答与专家们的说法背道而驰，专家们认为我们本可以也应该预见到它的到来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Are you not seeing the car in the car, that's on us?
sentences.zh: 你没看到车里的车吗，那是我们的责任？

sentences.en: Sir, do you still have a car?
sentences.zh: 先生，你还有车吗？

sentences.en: I'm shocked, Cheryl, that the Biden plan here definitely feels like it's borrowing from what Europe has been doing, especially in subsidizing home testing for COVID.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，我很震惊，拜登的这个计划绝对感觉像是借鉴了欧洲的做法，特别是在补贴COVID居家检测方面。

sentences.en: But when we think about what's going on in Europe, they're doing lots of testing.
sentences.zh: 但当我们想到欧洲正在发生的事情时，他们正在进行大量的检测。

sentences.en: And that doesn't seem to be altering the course of the pandemic all that much or improving it.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎并没有太大改变疫情的进程，也没有改善它。

sentences.en: And I know you said that at this point, really trying to contain the virus might not be a reasonable ambition.
sentences.zh: 我知道你说过，在这一点上，真正试图遏制病毒可能不是一个合理的抱负。

sentences.en: But that does raise the question of whether improving testing really does improve much of anything when it comes to this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但这确实提出了一个问题，即在应对这场大流行时，改善检测是否真的能改善什么。

sentences.en: Well, to that I would say we don't know what we don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对此我会说，我们不知道我们所不知道的。

sentences.en: In other words, we don't know how much worse it would be if we had no testing at all.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我们不知道如果我们根本不做检测，情况会糟糕到什么程度。

sentences.en: This is a very, very infectious variant.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常、非常具有传染性的变异株。

sentences.en: So I suppose you could say Europe is overrun.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜你可以说欧洲已经沦陷了。

sentences.en: It's giving us a lesson that the tests don't work at curbing the spread.
sentences.zh: 这给我们上了一课，即检测在遏制传播方面并不奏效。

sentences.en: But I don't think that's a reason not to try.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这不是不尝试的理由。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think I can speak for many of the 65 or so people in line in Brooklyn this morning in 31-degree weather
sentences.zh: 我想我可以代表今天早上在布鲁克林排队的65人左右，在31华氏度的天气里，

sentences.en: and say that they would have loved to have had an at-home COVID test, a reliable COVID test, rather than waiting three, four, maybe five hours in that freezing cold for a teSt.
sentences.zh: 说他们宁愿有一个居家COVID检测，一个可靠的COVID检测，而不是在严寒中等待三、四，也许五个小时来做检测。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think part of this is about the nation's psyche and enabling people to go about living their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 我认为这部分是关于国民心理，让人们能够继续过他们的日常生活。

sentences.en: You know, the pandemic has taken away a lot of agency, especially now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大流行夺走了很多自主权，尤其是现在。

sentences.en: It's left people feeling like things are out of control.
sentences.zh: 这让人们觉得事情失去了控制。

sentences.en: And these tests can give people some peace of mind.
sentences.zh: 而这些检测可以给人们一些内心的平静。

sentences.en: And they also might save some lives.
sentences.zh: 它们也可能挽救一些生命。

sentences.en: Well, Cheryl, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢丽尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael, as always.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔，一如既往。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, just as President Biden was announcing plans for a federal testing center in New York City,
sentences.zh: 周二，就在拜登总统宣布在纽约市建立联邦检测中心的计划时，

sentences.en: New York City officials said that they would open 23 new testing sites of their own by the end of the week to meet the surging demand.
sentences.zh: 纽约市官员表示，他们将在本周末前自行开设23个新的检测点，以满足激增的需求。

sentences.en: But there were new signs that the United States was still struggling to produce and conduct enough tests.
sentences.zh: 但有新的迹象表明，美国在生产和进行足够的检测方面仍然举步维艰。

sentences.en: Walgreens, the country's second largest pharmacy chain, said that due to unprecedented sales, it was imposing a limit on the purchase of at-home tests of four per customer.
sentences.zh: 全国第二大连锁药店沃尔格林表示，由于前所未有的销售额，它正在对居家检测盒的购买实行每位顾客限购四个的规定。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, health officials said that an unvaccinated man in Texas who died this week of COVID-19 had the Omicron strain of the virus, making him the first person in the country
sentences.zh: 周二，卫生官员表示，德克萨斯州一名未接种疫苗的男子本周死于COVID-19，他感染的是奥密克戎毒株，使他成为该国第一个

sentences.en: whose death has been publicly attributed to the variant.
sentences.zh: 其死亡被公开归因于该变异株的人。

sentences.en: Local officials blamed the man's death on underlying health conditions and his decision not to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 当地官员将该男子的死亡归咎于潜在的健康状况和他决定不接种疫苗。

sentences.en: The county where he lived, Harris County, is now averaging more than 2,000 new infections a day, five times the average from two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 他居住的哈里斯县目前平均每天新增超过2000例感染，是两周前平均水平的五倍。

sentences.en: And in response to the Omicron variant, several European countries, including Germany, Portugal, Scotland, and Sweden, are ordering tighter restrictions on gatherings.
sentences.zh: 为了应对奥密克戎变异株，包括德国、葡萄牙、苏格兰和瑞典在内的几个欧洲国家正在下令对聚会实施更严格的限制。

sentences.en: Sweden's new rules include a cap of 50 people for private gatherings and instructions that most people should work from home.
sentences.zh: 瑞典的新规定包括私人聚会人数上限为50人，并指示大多数人应该在家工作。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Portugal said it would shut down all nightclubs and make a negative test result required to enter establishments like theaters and sports venues.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，葡萄牙表示将关闭所有夜总会，并要求进入剧院和体育场馆等场所必须提供阴性检测结果。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Michael Simon Johnson, Robert Jemison, Daniel Guimet, and Austin Mitchell, with help from Paige Cowett, Sidney Harper, and Alexandra Lee Young.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由迈克尔·西蒙·约翰逊、罗伯特·杰米森、丹尼尔·吉梅特和奥斯汀·米切尔制作，佩奇·考特、西德尼·哈珀和亚历山德拉·李·杨提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Dave Shaw, contains original music by Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由戴夫·肖剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Winderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Winderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何你喜欢收听的地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。
